candidates.title: Rewarding defenders with bigger bug bounties

items.title: Rewarding defenders with bigger bug bounties
items.summary: OpenAI is raising Security Bug Bounty rewards and introducing report quality, loyalty, and priority campaign bonuses for independent security researchers.

candidates.title: Streamlining Contested Adjudications in Licensing Proceedings

items.title: Streamlining Contested Adjudications in Licensing Proceedings
items.summary: The U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC, agency, or Commission) is revising the agency's rules of practice and procedure to streamline contested adjudications in NRC licensing proceedings in response to the Accelerating Deployment of Versatile, Advanced Nuclear for Clean Energy Act of 2024 (ADVANCE Act) and Executive Order 14300, Ordering the Reform of the Nuclear Regulatory Commission.

items.title: Introducing the Grid Protectors Program
items.summary: OpenAI’s Grid Protectors Program will work with utilities to help future compute campuses support grid reliability and protect consumer electricity costs.

items.title: LifeVal
items.summary: Introducing LifeVal, a benchmark measuring how well AI helps people complete everyday tasks, from finding childcare to managing finances and government paperwork.
